content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The IISER Kolkata non-teaching selection process consists of the following stages: Shortlisting of online applications Computer Skill Test and/or Trade Test Written Examination Document Verification Medical fitness and verification of character and antecedents An institute-level Scrutiny Committee will examine the applications. If IISER Kolkata receives a large number of applications, candidates may be shortlisted based on qualifications, relevant experience and other prescribed criteria. Shortlisted candidates may be required to appear for a Computer Skill Test, Trade Test or both. These tests will be qualifying in nature, and their marks will not be added to the final written examination score. The final selection will be based on the merit of marks obtained in the written examination. The indicative post-wise syllabus is available on the IISER Kolkata recruitment website.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISER Kolkata Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the IISER Kolkata online recruitment portal at iiserkolnt.samarth.edu.in . Complete the registration process using an active email address and mobile number. Log in and select the required non-teaching post. Fill in the personal, educational, experience and category details carefully. Upload the required certificates and supporting documents. Pay the applicable application and registration fee online. Submit the online application by 19 October 2026 up to 5:30 PM. Download and print the PDF of the submitted application. Attach self-attested copies of all relevant certificates, testimonials and enclosures. Write “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF …………………” on the envelope. Send the application through Speed Post, Registered Post or courier so that it reaches IISER Kolkata by 29 October 2026 up to 5:30 PM. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application and pay the applicable fee for each post.

content_sections.text: Printed PDF of the submitted online application Recent photograph and signature Proof of date of birth Educational qualification certificates Semester-wise or year-wise mark sheets Experience certificates in the prescribed format SC, ST, OBC-NCL or EWS certificate, where applicable PwBD certificate, where applicable Ex-Servicemen certificate, where applicable Fee payment receipt Equivalence certificate for qualifications or pay levels, where applicable No Objection Certificate and Vigilance Certificate for candidates in government service, where applicable

content_sections.heading: Important Certificate Conditions
content_sections.text: OBC candidates must produce a valid OBC Non-Creamy Layer certificate in the Government of India format issued after 1 April 2026. EWS candidates must produce a valid Income and Asset Certificate for the financial year 2026–27 based on income for 2025–26. Experience certificates should mention the designation, service period, nature of duties and pay. The experience certificate must be issued on the organization’s letterhead and contain the issuing authority’s name, designation, signature and stamp. Certificates must be produced in original during document verification.

faq.question: Q1. What is IISER Kolkata Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a direct recruitment drive by the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Kolkata to fill 17 vacancies across 7 posts, notified vide Advt. No. IISER-K/Admn./NT-04/2026 dated 19.09.2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IISER Kolkata Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 17 vacancies are available across Senior Superintendent (1), Counsellor (1), Junior Engineer Civil (1), Nursing Assistant (1), Jr. Office Assistant MS (2), Jr. Assistant MS (10), and Attendant (1).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IISER Kolkata Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 19 October 2026, up to 17:30 Hrs.

faq.question: Q4. What posts are included in IISER Kolkata Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment includes Senior Superintendent, Counsellor, Junior Engineer Civil, Nursing Assistant, Junior Office Assistant, Junior Assistant and Attendant posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IISER Kolkata Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit varies from 30 to 40 years depending on the post. Government of India age-relaxation rules will apply to eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: General, OBC and EWS candidates must pay Rs.500. SC, ST, PwBD, Women, Ex-Servicemen and Transgender candidates are exempted from the Rs.450 application fee but must pay a Rs.50 registration fee.

faq.question: Q7. How will the final merit list be prepared?
faq.answer: The final selection will be based on marks obtained in the written examination. Skill or trade test marks will not be added to the final score.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the hard-copy application be sent?
faq.answer: The application must be sent to the Dean (Administration), Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Kolkata, Mohanpur, Nadia District, West Bengal – 741246.
